description: Commission of Elections - Media Guidelines to be followed/policies to be observed by the electronic and print media during a period of a Referendum and an Election
reasoning: This gazette content contains media guidelines specifically for "referenda and elections" issued by the Election Commission. It focuses entirely on electoral processes, including rules for media coverage during election periods, treatment of candidates, polling station regulations, and maintaining election integrity. The content falls under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7) as it deals with electoral processes and related matters rather than government personnel/structure changes or other specialized categories.
